binders: An arbitrary type Ω equipped with a measurable-space structure.
A measure μ on Ω together with an instance asserting that μ is a probability measure.
hypotheses: X is measurable from Ω to the Borel measurable real line.
conclusions: Let S be the set of t ∈ ENNReal such that X is measurable, t ≠ 0, t ≠ ∞, the function ω ↦ exp(X(ω)^2/(t.toReal)^2) is μ-integrable, and its μ-integral is at most 2. Then inf S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(B/sqrt(log 2)).
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef002(μ,X,t) means: X is measurable; t is a nonzero finite extended nonnegative real; ω ↦ exp(X(ω)^2/(t.toReal)^2) is μ-integrable; and ∫ exp(X(ω)^2/(t.toReal)^2) dμ ≤ 2.
LocalDef001(μ,X) is the order-theoretic infimum in ENNReal of all t satisfying LocalDef002(μ,X,t).
ENNReal.ofReal(r) embeds the nonnegative part max(r,0) of a real number into the extended nonnegative reals.
The hypothesis expressed through the μ-almost-everywhere filter permits violations of |X(ω)| ≤ B on a μ-null set.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every probability measure μ on a measurable space Ω, every measurable real-valued function X, and every positive real B such that |X| is at most B μ-almost everywhere, the infimum of the positive finite scales t for which exp(X^2/t^2) is μ-integrable with integral at most 2 is at most B divided by sqrt(log 2), with that real bound embedded into the extended nonnegative reals.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition applies only when the measure satisfies the supplied IsProbabilityMeasure predicate.
The function X must be measurable, and this condition is duplicated inside every admissible-scale predicate.
The boundedness assumption is only almost everywhere; values on μ-null sets are unrestricted.
B must be strictly positive, but it need not be the smallest or essential-supremum bound for X.
Candidate scales are ENNReal values but must be neither zero nor infinity, so only positive finite scales are admissible.
Integrability of the exponential is an explicit admissibility requirement, separate from the numerical integral bound.
LocalDef001 uses an order-theoretic infimum and does not state that the infimum is attained.
The definition does not separately assert that the admissible-scale set is nonempty; the complete-order convention governs the empty-set infimum.

ENNReal.ofReal truncates negative real inputs to zero. Under the stated positivity of B and the usual values of log 2 and square root, the displayed input is positive, but that positivity is not an explicit hypothesis.
No centering, zero-mean, symmetry, independence, or tail-probability hypothesis is encoded.
As an implication, the statement is logically vacuous whenever measurability, positivity of B, or the almost-everywhere bound fails.
ambiguities: The packet supplies only the type, not the constructors or fields, of MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure, so its exact internal normalization condition cannot be reconstructed from this dossier alone.
The definition body shown for MeasureTheory.integral is an opaque projection; its full convention outside the separately assumed integrable case is not exposed.
The exact definition of Nat.AtLeastTwo is not supplied, although it only participates in elaborating the numeral 2 and does not alter the mathematical binders or hypotheses.
